design: Fresh seed, same fixed eight generator profiles and six candidate threshold rules. Oracle pass/fail is held to one fixed 0.05-0.95/ESS-50 reference while each candidate is evaluated against it.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across 48 profile-by-candidate cells.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic comparison only. The fixed oracle criterion is a study reference, not a validated real-world definition of adequate overlap; no threshold is recommended.
prohibited_changes: Do not vary the fixed oracle reference criterion across candidate rows.
Do not use oracle assignment probabilities in propensity fitting or AIPW.
Do not treat this synthetic comparison as production threshold selection.
